name: Storefront and warehouse — external write live synchronization
note: A focused, independently runnable probe for an already-open storefront. The direct database writer is outside the application server, and this scenario measures only live propagation.

features.name: An open storefront follows a direct database write

criteria.desc: a direct database write sets Desk Lamp's East stock to 5, and the already-open storefront updates from 100 to 50 without a reload or page action
criteria.note: This proposed score remains draft until the focused pristine and mutation controls are qualified.
criteria.statedBy: when data changes by a path its server never saw
